castle.observation: Outdoor cursor selection and committed mouse movement independently compare both pointer axes with the party's 32-by-32 cell, producing a diagonal whenever the pointer is outside both its row and column.

playerProblem: Across Rebuilt's wider viewport, a small off-axis pointer error can select a long unintended diagonal and makes rapid map navigation feel unstable.
chosenBehavior: Pointer movement selects the dominant party-centered axis through four 90-degree cardinal wedges with one neutral party cell. Keyboard and keypad input retain every legal diagonal land direction.
